text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a clear, refreshing, and pleasant day.
Thinking it would be a waste to stay indoors,
I decided to enjoy a bicycle ride, but——

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Spotting a familiar figure, I involuntarily brought my bicycle to a stop.
It seemed like she was fussing over her leg...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Ah...
choice_data_list: What's wrong? Does your leg hurt?!
What's the matter? Is your leg hurting?!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Eh? No...
It's just that my shoelace snapped.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I was running so absorbed in the moment, and it just snapped.
I was just wondering what I should do...
choice_data_list: Ah... In that case, I think I have spares...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Ah... That's a lifesaver.
To think you carry those with you.
choice_data_list: I'm a Trainer, after all. Running essentials are a given.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I suppose I should do the same, but...
I really prefer not to carry luggage around.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
'How can I keep running just as I am now?'
...That was all that was on my mind.
choice_data_list: You really do love running, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ——Yes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka nodded without hesitation.
I mentioned to her that I had seen her racing against her juniors before, looking thoroughly content.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Is that so.
You were there.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
It really was lively the entire time we were running.
And yet, it didn't feel unpleasant in the slightest.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...I used to not be good with that.
Feeling cramped, all kinds of sounds reaching my ears
——running like that.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
That's why I loved the quiet scenery with no one around.
Even though that was how I ended up reaching the view from the front.
choice_data_list: Did you have a change of heart?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
Because... I began to hear 'voices.'

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
When running with someone. Their feelings, or rather...
I feel like I can hear their voice.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
As I listen to those voices,
I catch sight of worlds I never knew...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: They push me all the way to the lead——

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: And that scenery looks truly, truly special to me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I walked alongside her, the sound of crashing waves reached our ears.
It seemed that while talking, we had arrived at the coast.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
choice_data_list: This is a perfect spot for running.
It's a wonderful place to run, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Hah, hah, hah...! 
Fufu, what a nice breeze...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I rode along beside her on my bicycle.
Absorbed in her sprint, she looked truly full of joy.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, there it is again.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
If I hadn't bumped into you today,
I might not have made it here.
choice_data_list: I'm glad you like it. How are the shoes feeling?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
They feel great...! 
Thanks to you, I honestly feel like
I could keep running anywhere, forever——

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer-san!
May I...?!
choice_data_list: Go ahead, as hard as you want!
I'll do my best to catch up, so don't worry about me!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...!
I'm off!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, wait.
I have to say this first.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much... for bringing me
all the way here, to 'this view'...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Fufu, then if you don't mind...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka kicked off the ground with immense force.
In an instant, she transformed into the wind itself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, there was no way I could keep up...
Even so, even from a distance,
watching her conveyed something profound.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
——The world she runs in
is shining this brilliantly.
